claims.quote: We have high towers; the highest about half a mile in height; and some of them likewise set upon high mountains; so that the vantage of the hill with the tower is in the highest of them three miles at least.
claims.description: Very tall observation towers, some on mountains, used for weather observation and for insolation, refrigeration and conservation experiments.

claims.quote: We have also pools, of which some do strain fresh water out of salt; and others by art do turn fresh water into salt.
claims.description: Artificial pools that desalinate seawater into fresh water and the reverse.

claims.quote: We have likewise violent streams and cataracts, which serve us for many motions: and likewise engines for multiplying and enforcing of winds, to set also on going diverse motions.
claims.description: Harnessing water flows and wind-amplifying engines to drive machinery.

claims.quote: And amongst them we have a water which we call Water of Paradise, being, by that we do to it made very sovereign for health, and prolongation of life.
claims.description: A prepared water that promotes health and lengthens life.

claims.quote: We have also great and spacious houses where we imitate and demonstrate meteors; as snow, hail, rain, some artificial rains of bodies and not of water, thunders, lightnings; also generations of bodies in air; as frogs, flies, and divers others.
claims.description: Large facilities that artificially reproduce weather phenomena like rain, snow, hail, thunder and lightning.

claims.quote: We have also certain chambers, which we call Chambers of Health, where we qualify the air as we think good and proper for the cure of divers diseases, and preservation of health.
claims.description: Rooms with engineered air composition used to treat disease and preserve health.

claims.quote: And we make (by art) in the same orchards and gardens, trees and flowers to come earlier or later than their seasons; and to come up and bear more speedily than by their natural course they do.
claims.description: Artificial control of plant flowering and fruiting times and growth speed.

claims.quote: We make them also by art greater much than their nature; and their fruit greater and sweeter and of differing taste, smell, colour, and figure, from their nature.
claims.description: Deliberate breeding or manipulation to enlarge plants and alter fruit size, taste, smell and appearance.

claims.quote: We have also means to make divers plants rise by mixtures of earths without seeds; and likewise to make divers new plants, differing from the vulgar; and to make one tree or plant turn into another.
claims.description: Creating new plant species, growing plants without seeds, and transmuting one plant into another.

claims.quote: Wherein we find many strange effects; as continuing life in them, though divers parts, which you account vital, be perished and taken forth; resuscitating of some that seem dead in appearance; and the like.
claims.description: Animal experimentation sustaining life without vital organs and resuscitating apparently dead animals.

claims.quote: By art likewise, we make them greater or taller than their kind is; and contrariwise dwarf them, and stay their growth: we make them more fruitful and bearing than their kind is; and contrariwise barren and not generative.
claims.description: Artificially altering animal size, growth and fertility.

claims.quote: We find means to make commixtures and copulations of different kinds; which have produced many new kinds, and them not barren, as the general opinion is.
claims.description: Cross-breeding different species to produce new fertile species.

claims.quote: We make a number of kinds of serpents, worms, flies, fishes, of putrefaction; whereof some are advanced (in effect) to be perfect creatures, like bests or birds; and have sexes, and do propagate.
claims.description: Deliberately creating new reproducing animal species from putrefying matter with predictable outcomes.

claims.quote: whereof some of the drinks are such, as they are in effect meat and drink both: so that divers, especially in age, do desire to live with them, with little or no meat or bread.
claims.description: Nutritional drinks that serve as complete food replacing solid meals.

claims.quote: insomuch as some of them put upon the back of your hand will, with a little stay, pass through to the palm, and yet taste mild to the mouth.
claims.description: Liquids so fine that they pass through the skin of the hand.

claims.quote: We have some meats also and breads and drinks, which taken by men enable them to fast long after; and some other, that used make the very flesh of men's bodies sensibly more hard and tough and their strength far greater than otherwise it would be.
claims.description: Foods that enable long fasting and enhance bodily toughness and strength.

claims.quote: We have also perspective-houses, where we make demonstrations of all lights and radiations; and of all colours: and out of things uncoloured and transparent, we can represent unto you all several colours
claims.description: Optical laboratories demonstrating light, radiation and colour production from transparent materials.

claims.quote: We find also divers means, yet unknown to you, of producing of light originally from divers bodies.
claims.description: New methods of generating light from various materials.

claims.quote: We procure means of seeing objects afar off; as in the heaven and remote places; and represent things near as afar off; and things afar off as near; making feigned distances.
claims.description: Optical instruments like telescopes for viewing the heavens and distant places, and for manipulating apparent distance.

claims.quote: We have also glasses and means to see small and minute bodies perfectly and distinctly; as the shapes and colours of small flies and worms, grains and flaws in gems, which cannot otherwise be seen, observations in urine and blood not otherwise to be seen.
claims.description: Microscopes that reveal tiny organisms and allow observation of blood and urine for medical purposes.

claims.quote: We have also sound-houses, where we practise and demonstrate all sounds, and their generation. We have harmonies which you have not, of quarter-sounds, and lesser slides of sounds.
claims.description: Acoustic laboratories producing new musical harmonies using microtones.

claims.quote: We represent and imitate all articulate sounds and letters, and the voices and notes of beasts and birds.
claims.description: Artificial synthesis of speech and animal sounds.

claims.quote: We have certain helps which set to the ear do further the hearing greatly.
claims.description: Hearing aids that greatly improve hearing.

claims.quote: We have also means to convey sounds in trunks and pipes, in strange lines and distances.
claims.description: Transmitting sound through tubes and pipes over long distances, like speaking tubes or telephony.

claims.quote: We multiply smells, which may seem strange. We imitate smells, making all smells to breathe outs of other mixtures than those that give them.
claims.description: Synthetic reproduction and multiplication of smells from different ingredients.

claims.quote: We make divers imitations of taste likewise, so that they will deceive any man's taste.
claims.description: Artificial flavours that perfectly imitate other tastes.

claims.quote: There we imitate and practise to make swifter motions than any you have, either out of your muskets or any engine that you have: and to make them and multiply them more easily, and with small force, by wheels and other means
claims.description: Engines producing faster, stronger motions and projectiles than contemporary muskets and cannon, exceeding them in power.

claims.quote: and likewise new mixtures and compositions of gun-powder, wild-fires burning in water, and unquenchable.
claims.description: New gunpowder compositions and incendiary fires that burn on water and cannot be extinguished.

claims.quote: We imitate also flights of birds; we have some degrees of flying in the air.
claims.description: Heavier-than-air artificial flight based on imitating birds.

claims.quote: We have ships and boats for going under water, and brooking of seas; also swimming-girdles and supporters.
claims.description: Submarines, sea-going boats and flotation devices for swimmers.

claims.quote: We have divers curious clocks, and other like motions of return: and some perpetual motions.
claims.description: Perpetual motion machines.

claims.quote: We imitate also motions of living creatures, by images, of men, beasts, birds, fishes, and serpents.
claims.description: Mechanical automata imitating the movements of living creatures.

claims.quote: And we do also declare natural divinations of diseases, plagues, swarms-of hurtful creatures, scarcity, tempests, earthquakes, great inundations, comets, temperature of the year, and divers other things; and we give counsel thereupon
claims.description: Scientific prediction of diseases, plagues, storms, earthquakes, floods, comets and harvests, with advice on prevention.

claims.quote: We have three that try new experiments, such as themselves think good. These we call Pioneers or Miners.
claims.description: A state-supported institution organizing systematic collaborative scientific research with specialized divisions of labor.

claims.quote: For upon every invention of value, we erect a statue to the inventor, and give him a liberal and honourable reward.
claims.description: A society that publicly honors and financially rewards inventors.
